description_en: Use this API to query inbound call records by criteria
description_zh: 通过本接口，可以根据条件查询来电通话记录
kebab_example: aliyun dyvmsapi cloud-query-ib-cdr --enterprise-id 7000002 --unique-id uniq_1-162046xxxx.12 --status 1 --province '北京' --city '北京' --time-range-type 1 --start-time 1775024775 --end-time 1775030413 --start 0 --limit 10 --user-fieldkey userFieldkey --user-field-value userFieldvalue --customer-number 17750247753 --cno 1111 --qno 566 --leave-queue-code 2 --join-queue-code 3 --callee-number 41008502 --hotline 10003221 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CloudQueryIbCdr

parameters.description_en: Specifies how the time range defined by `StartTime` and `EndTime` applies to the query. This parameter is used only when both `StartTime` and `EndTime` are specified. Valid values are `1` for call start time and `2` for call end time. Default: `1`.
